title: 贝多芬大提琴奏鸣曲海报
author: Juan José Arango E.
categories: 海报 / 传单,插画,复古 / 怀旧,产品,文字 / 排版
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a dramatic Spanish editorial poster about Beethoven Sonata para violonchelo y piano n.º 3, Op. 69, presenting it as an essential classical music discovery.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 poster, dark near-black background, vintage concert-program texture, slightly distressed print grain, high contrast, elegant museum/exhibition design.

Layout: Left side dominated by large Spanish typography; center-right dominated by a tall cello collage; lower-right contains piano keys and a small handwritten sheet-music fragment; upper-right contains a vertical timeline of notable performers with circular photo medallions. Use layered geometric shapes, thin technical diagram lines, waveform curves, dotted grids, and subtle music-notation details.

Main text content: At upper left, set a stacked serif headline in white with one red emphasis line: “TODOS LOS GRANDES CHELISTAS DEL SIGLO XX SUPIERON QUE ESTA SONATA ERA DIFERENTE.” Make “ESTA SONATA” red. Below it, use huge condensed distressed block lettering for the question: “¿POR QUÉ USTED NO LA HA ESCUCHADO AÚN?” Make “USTED NO” bright red, most other words off-white, and “AÚN?” ochre-gold. Under the question, add a small italic sentence in warm beige: “Estoy casi seguro de que la conoce. Buen momento para volver a escucharla.” At the bottom, add the composer name in large warm cream: “Beethoven”, and beneath it in bold white: “Sonata para violonchelo y piano n.º 3, Op. 69”.

Central subject: A large upright cello, cropped from top to bottom, centered slightly right. Make it a mixed-media collage: realistic wood grain, black strings, visible bridge and f-holes, semi-transparent overlays, red vertical rectangle through the upper body, amber-orange lower bout, beige circular moon-like disk behind it, and worn paper textures. The cello should overlap abstract sound-wave lines that travel from the left typography toward the instrument.

Right timeline: Include exactly 4 circular performer medallions connected by a thin vertical line with small nodes. Labels must read exactly: 1) “ROSTROPOVICH Y RICHTER, 1963”, 2) “CASALS Y SERKIN, 1952”, 3) “YO-YO MA Y EMANUEL AX, 1985”, 4) “ALISA WEILERSTEIN, 2022”. Use small sepia or black-and-white portrait-style musician images inside the circles, with names in ochre uppercase and years in pale cream.

Visual style: Sophisticated classical-music magazine cover meets Bauhaus concert poster; dark navy-black, ivory, scarlet red, ochre gold, muted teal, and sepia; distressed ink, aged paper, fine scratches, subtle halftone, and layered collage. Typography should feel bold, Spanish, editorial, and cinematic, with a mix of elegant serif text and massive condensed sans-serif display type.

Constraints: Keep all visible text in Spanish exactly as specified. Do not add logos, watermarks, modern UI elements, or extra performer entries. Maintain strong readability despite the vintage grunge texture.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a vertical three-panel fantasy food-comedy manga page about a blonde female knight from another world trying modern Japanese foods, with dramatic gourmet reactions.

Canvas: Tall portrait manga page, 675×1012 aspect ratio, three horizontal panels stacked vertically with thick black borders and narrow white gutters. High-detail color anime illustration, glossy rendering, cinematic lighting, expressive manga effects.

Main character: A young adult blonde female knight with long hair, bangs, side braids, and polished silver plate armor with gauntlets. She sits at a tavern table in panels 1 and 2, then reacts dramatically in panel 3. Her face is covered by a plain skin-tone rectangular censor block in the first two panels only; in the third panel her face is visible, sweating, disgusted, and pinching her nose.

Panel 1: Warm medieval tavern interior with wooden beams, lanterns, a red dragon banner, and a green goblin-like patron in the background. The knight holds a spoonful of curry rice in her metal gauntlet. A plate of curry and white rice sits in front of her, with a drinking glass at the lower left. Add golden sparkles and small pink heart effects around her. Include exactly 3 rounded white speech bubbles on the right.

Panel 2: Close-up, dreamy pink background with bubbles, sparkles, and soft glowing light. The knight holds a custard pudding in a glass cup with caramel sauce on top, using a spoon in her other gauntlet. Her hair flows softly and the mood is heavenly and sweet. Include exactly 5 rounded white speech bubbles stacked vertically on the left.

Panel 3: Dark blue-purple dramatic manga background with speed lines and shock hatching. The knight holds chopsticks lifting sticky natto over a small white tray. Brown fermented beans stretch in stringy strands. She recoils with disgust, one hand pinching her nose, sweating heavily, eyes wide, mouth open in horror. Include exactly 2 jagged explosive speech bubbles: one large vertical bubble on the left and one on the right.

Text content: Use Japanese manga lettering with this dialogue layout: Panel 1 right bubbles: 「これがカレーね」, 「うん、最初は不安だったけど、食べたら美味しい」, 「なかなか、刺激的な味ね」. Panel 2 left bubbles: 「プリン…」, 「魅惑的な甘さ…」, 「口の中でとろける…」, 「幸せ〜」, 「ここは天国？天国なの？」. Panel 3 left jagged bubble: 「うっ…くっさーーっ!!!」. Panel 3 right jagged bubble: 「な、納豆…？なにこれ…臭すぎる…！絶対ムリ…！」

Style constraints: Detailed anime fantasy manga, polished armor reflections, appetizing food close-ups, expressive comedic contrast between delicious curry, heavenly pudding, and disgusting natto. No watermark, no extra panels, no extra speech bubbles.\

Goal: Create a black-and-white manga-style two-panel comic about a cute guilty dog and a broken desktop computer, using expressive screentone shading, clean ink outlines, dramatic reaction marks, and Japanese speech bubbles.

Canvas: Vertical comic page, approximately 2:3 aspect ratio, with a thick black outer border and one horizontal divider splitting the page into exactly 2 stacked panels.

Panel 1: Show a home office desk scene in grayscale. On the left side of the desk are exactly 4 visible computer-related items: a cracked smoking monitor with a shattered screen, an open desktop PC tower with exposed internal parts, a keyboard in the foreground, and a wired mouse near the center. Add scattered debris, broken fragments, loose cables, small sparks, and dark smoke rising from both the cracked monitor and the damaged tower. In the center foreground sits a small cute puppy, a round-faced mixed-breed dog with floppy ears, large glossy eyes, a white muzzle and chest, darker patches on the ears and body, a collar with a small round tag, and a terrified guilty expression with sweat drops. In the right background, a young woman enters through a doorway, surprised; her face is intentionally obscured by a soft square blur. She has long wavy hair, wears a plain long-sleeve top, slim jeans, and slippers. Add a bookshelf, framed picture, potted plant, chair edge, doorframe, and simple room details in the background. Include exactly 1 speech bubble in this panel, coming from the woman, with vertical Japanese text: あ、あ….

Panel 2: Show the same puppy now smiling brightly and posing innocently on the desk, turned slightly backward with one paw reaching behind its body as if hiding or covering the damaged computer tower. The dog should look adorable, playful, and suspiciously pleased, with sparkling effects beside its face. The broken desktop tower is behind the dog on the right, still smoking, with exposed components and a dangling cable. The desk includes exactly 3 visible desk items: keyboard, wired mouse, and a mug holding pencils. Background includes a shelf with books, a framed wall picture, a potted plant, and soft indoor room shading. Include exactly 1 speech bubble in this panel, on the left, with bold vertical Japanese text: 何でもない！.

Subject details: The dog is a cute small mixed-breed puppy, with white fur with gray patches, floppy ears, and a white blaze down the face. The woman is a young woman with long wavy hair, casual sweater, jeans, slippers, and a blurred face.

Visual style: Monochrome Japanese manga illustration, soft pencil-like texture, detailed linework, expressive character acting, dramatic smoke and sparks, cute comedic tone, high contrast but not overly dark, realistic home office perspective mixed with exaggerated manga emotions.

Constraints: Use exactly 2 panels, exactly 2 speech bubbles total, exactly 1 dog, exactly 1 woman, and exactly 1 broken desktop computer setup. Keep all text in Japanese as specified, avoid extra captions, avoid color, avoid watermark or logo.\

author: TWnese

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a dramatic vintage World War II commemorative poster for D-DAY, showing the Allied invasion of Normandy on June 6, 1944.

Canvas: Landscape 4:3 poster, aged parchment background with sepia, charcoal, olive drab, navy ink, and weathered paper texture. Use a gritty illustrated realism style, like a historical war magazine cover mixed with a hand-painted military poster.

Layout: Place one dominant U.S. infantry soldier in the left foreground, waist-up to knees, charging through shallow surf toward the viewer. His face is deliberately hidden by one flat opaque dark-brown square censor block centered over the face. Put the large headline “D-DAY” across the upper right in huge dark navy serif capital letters. Beneath it, add a thin horizontal rule with a small centered star, then the subtitle “ALLIED INVASION OF NORMANDY, JUNE 6, 1944” in condensed uppercase lettering.

Subject details: The foreground soldier wears a wet olive drab uniform, netted M1 helmet, webbing straps, ammunition pouches, backpack straps, and a U.S. flag patch on his upper right sleeve. He grips a long rifle diagonally downward across his body. Make his clothing soaked, muddy, and reflective with splashes of seawater around his legs. The background shows a Normandy beach landing: exactly 2 landing craft with open ramps on the left and middle distance, exactly 14 visible infantry figures moving through the water and across the beach, exactly 7 aircraft silhouettes in the smoky sky, exactly 3 large explosion plumes near the shoreline, and exactly 2 Czech hedgehog anti-tank obstacles in the right foreground.

Environment: Rough gray surf, beach obstacles, distant cliffs and fortifications, smoke columns, artillery bursts, and chaotic battlefield haze. The scene should feel heroic, somber, and historically documentary rather than glamorous.

Text content: Use D-DAY as the main title and “ALLIED INVASION OF NORMANDY, JUNE 6, 1944” as the subtitle. Keep the typography distressed, ink-worn, and integrated into the aged poster texture.

Constraints: No modern objects, no clean digital gloss, no extra text, no watermark, no logos, no gore, and keep the soldier’s face fully obscured by the brown square.\

Canvas: Square 1:1 composition, soft light-gray studio background, rounded white display cards with subtle shadows, high-resolution product-ad style.

Layout: Show exactly 3 devices in a balanced grid: 1 large silver laptop centered across the top, 1 black-bezel tablet at bottom left, and 1 black-edged smartphone at bottom right. Each device sits inside its own rounded white rectangular card. The laptop card is widest; the tablet and phone cards are smaller and aligned beneath it with a narrow gap between them.

Wallpaper scene: A soft watercolor/anime winter landscape with a snowy forest, pale misty sky, snow-covered evergreen trees, bushes, and a white snowy field. The scene should feel gentle, nostalgic, and cute, with falling snow and cool blue-white tones. In the foreground include exactly 6 cartoon figures from left to right: 1 bundled child in a dark blue winter hat and blue coat holding snow, 1 small girl in a pink winter outfit, 1 central mischievous boy in a red sweater and yellow shorts running happily with arms raised, 1 small blond child in a green outfit, 1 stocky child in a yellow shirt walking at the right, and 1 small white dog running near the center-right. Keep the characters in a playful Crayon Shin-chan anime style with simple rounded features and expressive poses.

Device details: The laptop is open front-facing with a thin black bezel, centered notch at the top of the screen, silver keyboard and trackpad visible. The tablet is landscape orientation with thick black bezel and rounded corners. The smartphone is vertical with a pill-shaped dynamic-island cutout and slim black frame.

Lock-screen overlays: Add subtle translucent iOS-style lock-screen UI on the devices. Use the time 9:38 prominently in white or light gray. Use the date Friday, November 15 above the time. On the tablet, include a translucent weather widget block at upper left showing Cupertino 45° Clear and three small circular widget icons beneath it. On the phone, include three small circular widgets under the time and two lock-screen icons near the bottom. Keep all UI text soft and semi-transparent so the wallpaper remains the focus.

Visual style: Premium Apple-like presentation, realistic device mockup lighting, soft shadows, rounded white cards, crisp screens, gentle winter palette, charming watercolor background, cute anime characters, no harsh contrast.

Constraints: Use exactly 3 devices and exactly 6 wallpaper characters/animals. Do not add extra characters, logos, watermarks, captions, or promotional text outside the device screens. The wallpaper must be visibly the same scene adapted to desktop, tablet, and phone crops.\

prompt_en:
Automatically generate a museum-encyclopedia-style Chinese deconstruction infographic from the [theme] I provide.

Combine a realistic central visual with structural breakdown, Chinese leader-line callouts, material notes, pattern symbolism, color meaning, and a core-feature summary. From the theme alone, infer the most fitting subject, costume system, object structure, historical era, key components, materials and craftsmanship, color palette, and overall layout. No extra input required from me.

Overall aesthetic: National Museum exhibition board, historical costume encyclopedia, scholarly subject infographic. Not a poster, ancient-style portrait, e-commerce detail page, or anime illustration. Background uses paper textures, off-white, silk-paper white, or light tea-color, with a premium, restrained, collectible feel.

Fixed layout:
- Top: Chinese main title + subtitle + short intro
- Left: structural deconstruction area, Chinese leader-line annotations on key components, with partial close-ups
- Top right: materials / craft / texture area, real texture swatches with descriptions
- Middle right: pattern / color / symbolism area, main color palette, pattern samples, cultural notes
- Bottom: dressing order / assembly flowchart + summary of core features

If the theme suits a human subject, use a realistic full-body standing figure as the centerpiece. If it suits an object or single structure, switch to a central deconstruction diagram, but keep the overall infographic format intact. All text in Simplified Chinese, clear, neat, readable, no garbled glyphs, typos, English, or pinyin. Emphasize realistic structure, material contrast, cultural commentary, and an encyclopedic feel.

Avoid: poster vibe, studio-photo vibe, e-commerce vibe, anime vibe, cosplay vibe, messy annotations, wrong structure, blurry text, fake materials, excessive decoration.\
